# v1.16.0 - Agentic Delivery, Worktrees and AI Code Review
## Projects 24 v1.16.0: Agentic Delivery, Worktrees and AI Code Review

Work that outgrows one session runs in fresh contexts with state on disk, parallel agents get their own worktrees, and AI code review reports exactly what it did.

### Key Highlights
- **Rule 18 (`18-agentic-delivery-and-review.md`)**: fresh context per unit, worktree isolation, unattended runs bounded and sandboxed without permission bypass, AI review outcomes reported exactly.
- **Skill `agent-delivery-loop`**: the GSD phase loop and the Ralph story loop (adapted from open-gsd/gsd-core and snarktank/ralph, MIT), with a tested stories checker (8 tests) and loop runner (6 tests).
- **Skill `git-worktrees`**: one task, one branch, one worktree; tested `worktrees.mjs` (6 tests), adapted from coderabbitai/git-worktree-runner.
- **Skill `coderabbit-review`**: CodeRabbit CLI and pull request reviews with a tested outcome classifier (9 tests) and a schema-validated `.coderabbit.yaml` template.

### Verification
- Local checks before release: `npm run verify` (spec checks, Biome, script tests), 29 helper tests, schema validation of the CodeRabbit template, link check of the new files.
- CI results for this tag: see the Validate workflow run in the Actions tab. The release-notes check failed on the original tag because this file was missing; it was added afterwards.
